Good morning. My order ID is ORD-22006. 

Actually, I ordered a crockery set for Rs 2,199, but when the delivery person handed over the box, it was visibly crushed. I could actually hear broken pieces inside the package. I have also taken photos before opening it, just to be safe. Could you please check the delivery status and arrange for a replacement shipment or a refund for these carrier-damaged goods? Kindly do the needful at the earliest.
